name: family-site-blocker
description: Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox extension that blocks adult websites

scripts.package:firefox: rm -f dist/family-site-blocker-firefox.zip && mkdir -p dist && cd extension && zip -qrX ../dist/family-site-blocker-firefox.zip . -x '_metadata/*' -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:firefox
